PRODUCTION WORKFLOW

What the finished importer will automate

1Accept batches of product packages instead of requiring 1,500 individual Add Product sessions.
2Inspect ZIP contents, ignore system junk files, detect likely preview images and identify included file formats.
3Apply batch defaults such as Original vs. PLR/MRR, category and Draft status once across many products.
4Keep source/license notes private and flag licensed batches that still need rights review before publishing.
5Queue listings for your review so automation handles repetition while you keep control of titles, pricing, presentation and final Publish.
